rule:
A device is the source of an update ONLY if the update's sidecar carries a P-256 ECDSA-SHA256 signature ('p256') by one of these PUBLIC keys over 'rlab-device-update-v1
<fp>
<kind>
<id>
<version>
<name>
<size>
<sha256>'. A 'source'/'from'/'device' label alone is NOT a signature and is refused. Size + sha256 are always checked. Owner key e5833fdfbbfe (ed25519, rlab-update-v1) is accepted for every op. Unsigned / unknown device / revoked / op not allowed = refused.
pinning: Apps PIN this list in their bundle/code. A remote copy is only used if it is itself owner-signed (e5833fdfbbfe). Public keys only: no private key is ever in this file or held by a bot.
